• Pets are allowed on Amtrak trains, but they must be in a carrier or on a leash and must not disturb other passengers.
• The station itself is pet‑friendly, but you’ll need to check the specific rules for each service (e.g., Tri‑Rail has its own pet policy). | ### How to Check Pet Policies - **Amtrak**: Visit the [Amtrak Pet Policy page](https://www.amtrak.com/pets) or call 1‑800‑AMTRAK (1‑800‑226‑4727). - **Tri‑Rail**: Check the [Tri‑Rail Pet Policy](https://www.tri-rail.org/tri-rail-pet-policy) or call 305‑555‑1234. - **Local Transit (Metrobus, Metrorail)**: Most buses and trains allow pets in carriers; check the specific transit agency’s website or call their customer service line. --- ## 2. Other Nearby Stations | Station | Service | Pet Policy | |---------|---------|------------| | **Miami Airport (MIA) – Amtrak & Metrobus** | Amtrak, Metrobus | Pets allowed on Amtrak in carriers; Metrobus allows pets in carriers or on a leash. | | **Miami Beach (Tri‑Rail)** | Tri‑Rail | Pets allowed on Tri‑Rail in carriers or on a leash; check the Tri‑Rail website for details. | | **Miami International Airport (MIA) – Tri‑Rail** | Tri‑Rail | Same as above. | --- ## 3. Tips for Traveling with Pets in Miami 1. **Book Early**: Reserve a pet spot on Amtrak or Tri‑Rail in advance. 2. **Carry a Carrier**: Most services require pets to be in a carrier that fits under the seat. 3. **Bring Identification**: Keep your pet’s ID tags and a copy of their vaccination records handy. 4. **Check Local Regulations**: Some areas in Miami may have specific rules about pets in public spaces. 5. **Plan for Comfort**: Bring water, a small snack, and a familiar blanket or toy to keep your pet calm. --- ## 4. Useful Links - **Amtrak Pet Policy**: https://www.amtrak.com/pets - **Tri‑Rail Pet Policy**: https://www.tri-rail.org/tri-rail-pet-policy - **Miami Intermodal Center**: https://www.miamiintermodalcenter.com/ - **Miami-Dade Transit**: https://www.miamidade.gov/transit/ --- If you need more specific details—such as exact pet fees, size restrictions, or how to reserve a pet spot—please let me know, and I can help you look up the latest information or guide you through the booking process.
